name: Bitwise Orthogonality Camouflage
description: Replaces the arithmetic product condition ($c_u \times c_v = 2$) with a bitwise AND condition ($s_u \& s_v = 0$). For values restricted to $\{1, 2\}$, this is mathematically equivalent to forcing opposite assignments, but it breaks pattern matching for models that look for explicit multiplication or bipartite graph wording.
